name: Inn
description: A business offering rooms for travelers, usually with meals and a common room.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of inn: A business offering rooms for travelers, usually with meals and a common room.
flavour: Firelight flickers across the tabletops, and the smell of fresh bread drifts from a nearby doorway. Above you, floorboards creak beneath someone’s slow footsteps.
discovery: Behind a loose drawer in a guest room lies a folded route map with one stopping place carefully crossed out.
readAloud: A worn staircase rises beside a hearth, with wooden tables filling the common room below.

name: Tavern
description: A place serving drinks and often food, primarily for socializing. It does not necessarily offer lodging.
imageAlt: Timber tavern with glowing windows, outdoor tables and barrels beside a cobbled road at sunset.
flavour: Smoke curls beneath the beams, carrying the smell of roasting onions and spilled ale. Tankards knock against the tables beneath a murmur of conversation.
discovery: Repeated scratches beneath one table form a crude map of the nearby streets, with a doorway marked by a small star.
readAloud: Scarred tables and mismatched chairs crowd a low-beamed room around a glowing hearth.

name: General Store
description: A shop selling everyday supplies such as rope, lanterns, soap, sacks and travel provisions.
imageAlt: Village general store with an open doorway and baskets, sacks and supplies displayed outside.
flavour: Coils of rope brush the shelves as the door opens, setting a small bell jingling. The close air smells of soap, lamp oil and dry grain.
discovery: A sack among the deliveries contains smooth river stones instead of the grain named on its label.
readAloud: Shelves of jars, tools and folded cloth surround a counter crowded with sacks and bundled supplies.

name: Blacksmith’s Forge
description: A workshop where metal is heated and shaped into tools, nails, horseshoes and other goods. Weapons and armor may require a specialist.
imageAlt: Open blacksmith workshop with a glowing forge, anvil, hammers and horseshoes.
flavour: Sparks scatter across the floor as a hammer strikes glowing metal. Heat washes over your face, followed by the sharp hiss of water and the smell of coal smoke.
discovery: A newly repaired tool bears an unfamiliar maker’s mark beneath its handle, hidden by a strip of worn wrapping.
readAloud: A red-hot forge illuminates an anvil surrounded by hammers, iron scraps and unfinished tools.

name: Apothecary
description: A shop preparing and selling medicinal herbs, remedies and ointments. Magical potions may be available in some settings.
imageAlt: Warm apothecary interior with shelves of bottles, hanging herbs and a worktable covered in plants and remedies.
flavour: Bundles hanging from the rafters turn gently in a draft, releasing a bitter herbal scent. Beneath them, a copper still drips steadily into a narrow flask.
discovery: One jar has two labels, and the older name beneath the peeling paper does not match its contents.
readAloud: Rows of glass bottles line the walls above a worktable covered in dried herbs and stained bowls.

name: Market Square
description: An open public area where vendors sell goods from stalls or carts, also used for announcements and gatherings.
imageAlt: Cobbled town market square with canvas stalls, produce and timber buildings in the evening light.
flavour: Their loose edges snap in the breeze above vendors calling to passing customers. Rattling wheels roll through damp straw, and the air smells of ripe fruit and fresh bread.
discovery: A loose paving stone conceals a shallow recess containing several trade tokens from distant markets.
readAloud: Canvas awnings stretch over rows of stalls and loaded carts between the buildings surrounding the square.

name: Chapel
description: A small place of worship serving a local community, with an altar and space for ceremonies.
imageAlt: Small stone chapel with a bell tower, an arched doorway and flowers along a cobbled path.
flavour: Its light falls across worn floor tiles and candles burning beside the altar. The flames lean in a faint draft that carries the smell of wax and cool stone.
discovery: An inscription beneath the altar cloth names an earlier dedication, still legible under layers of later carving.
readAloud: Rows of wooden seats face a modest altar beneath a narrow window of coloured glass.

name: Watchhouse
description: A base for local guards where residents report crimes. It may include offices, equipment storage and holding cells.
imageAlt: Stone and timber watchhouse with blue banners, a tower and a fortified arched entrance.
flavour: Damp cloaks hang near the entrance, leaving the smell of wet wool and oiled leather. Beyond the desk, keys clink and boot heels echo along the passage.
discovery: Two copies of a recent entry in the watch ledger disagree about which gate was used.
readAloud: A heavy desk stands before a stone passage lined with equipment racks and thick, iron-bound doors.

name: Private Residence
description: Someone’s home, ranging from a modest cottage to a wealthy townhouse, with rooms reflecting the occupants’ daily lives.
imageAlt: Timber and stone cottage with glowing windows, a fenced garden and flowers beside the front door.
flavour: Curtains shift beside a slightly open window, its latch clicking in the breeze. From deeper inside comes the smell of cooking and the soft scrape of a chair.
discovery: A patch of newer plaster conceals a shallow wall niche containing a bundle of old household letters.
readAloud: Worn rugs lead through a hallway lined with framed keepsakes and doorways into furnished rooms.

name: Stables
description: A building housing riding and pack animals. Staff may provide feed, boarding, grooming and mounts for hire.
imageAlt: Timber stable with horses in open stalls, hay, saddles and a stone water trough.
flavour: Horses shift beneath a swaying lantern, their hooves scraping against the boards. Warm hay and worn leather scent the air as one animal gives a low snort.
discovery: A saddle’s inner lining hides a narrow pocket holding a hand-drawn trail map.
readAloud: Wooden stalls line a straw-covered aisle, with saddles and bridles hanging from pegs along the walls.

name: Docks / Ferry Landing
description: A waterside place where boats load passengers and goods. Docks hold moored vessels; ferry landings serve crossings.
imageAlt: Wooden riverside landing with mooring posts and a covered ferry beneath a sunset sky.
flavour: The boats rise and settle, pulling the ropes taut with small creaks. Water slaps the supports below, carrying the smell of wet timber and river mud.
discovery: At low water, a small sealed box becomes visible beneath the landing, caught between two support beams.
readAloud: Weather-darkened boards extend over the water toward mooring posts and boats secured by thick ropes.

name: Roadside Campsite
description: A stopping place beside a travel route where people pitch tents, rest and cook.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of roadside campsite: A stopping place beside a travel route where people pitch tents, rest and cook.
flavour: Charred sticks lie among the ashes, still carrying a faint smoky smell. Beyond the cleared ground, dry grass whispers in the passing breeze.
discovery: Beneath the newest ash layer, a discarded scrap of cloth carries a stitched symbol and a few grains of glittering sand.
readAloud: A ring of blackened stones sits in a patch of flattened grass beside the road.

name: River Ford
description: A shallow stretch of river where people and animals cross without a bridge. Rain can make it dangerous.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of river ford: A shallow stretch of river where people and animals cross without a bridge. Rain can make it dangerous.
flavour: Clear water curls around them, bending ribbons of weed downstream. The current rushes steadily, broken by the clatter of pebbles rolling along the riverbed.
discovery: A line of submerged marker stones reveals a shallower crossing a little upstream from the obvious path.
readAloud: Pale stones break the river’s surface between muddy tracks descending from either bank.

name: Forest Clearing
description: An open area surrounded by trees, suitable for resting, camping or meeting.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of forest clearing: An open area surrounded by trees, suitable for resting, camping or meeting.
flavour: Leaves shift overhead, moving the bright patches across moss and fallen branches. The air smells of damp earth and sap, and insects hum in the warmth.
discovery: A ring of half-buried stones outlines an older fire pit beneath the grass, with a small carved bead among the ashes.
readAloud: A grassy clearing opens between tall trees, with patches of sunlight scattered across the ground.

name: Hunter’s Cabin
description: A small dwelling used by a hunter or trapper, usually containing a bed, fireplace, tools and supplies.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of hunter’s cabin: A small dwelling used by a hunter or trapper, usually containing a bed, fireplace, tools and supplies.
flavour: A thin thread of smoke rises from the chimney and drifts between the branches. The breeze carries pine smoke and makes the loose door latch rattle.
discovery: Notches on the doorframe match a series of marks on a nearby trail, leading to a carefully concealed supply cache.
readAloud: A small timber cabin stands among the trees, with stacked firewood beside its weathered door.

name: Rock Shelter
description: A space beneath an overhanging rock or cliff that offers partial protection from weather.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of rock shelter: A space beneath an overhanging rock or cliff that offers partial protection from weather.
flavour: Beads of water gather along its edge and fall into a shallow hollow. Beneath the rock, the air is cool and smells of damp stone.
discovery: Faded handprints surround a narrow crevice where a small clay container has been pushed out of sight.
readAloud: A broad overhang casts a deep shadow across a strip of bare ground at the foot of the cliff.

name: Marsh Boardwalk
description: A raised wooden walkway across wet ground, allowing travelers to pass without sinking into the marsh.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of marsh boardwalk: A raised wooden walkway across wet ground, allowing travelers to pass without sinking into the marsh.
flavour: The reeds sway against the walkway as its timbers groan beneath your steps. Insects drone over the stagnant water, where bubbles rise through the mud.
discovery: One replacement plank lifts easily, revealing a dry-wrapped packet tied to the support beneath it.
readAloud: A narrow line of wooden planks winds above dark pools and dense stands of reeds.

name: Mountain Trail
description: A walking route through steep terrain, often narrow and uneven, where travelers may move single file.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of mountain trail: A walking route through steep terrain, often narrow and uneven, where travelers may move single file.
flavour: A few pieces of grit slide away beneath your boots and tumble down the slope. Cold wind pulls at your clothing and whistles through the fractured rock.
discovery: An old cairn contains a flat stone scratched with directions to a sheltered route through the ridge.
readAloud: A narrow trail cuts across a steep mountainside, with loose stones scattered along its outer edge.

name: Lakeshore
description: The edge of a lake, with possible beaches, reeds, fishing spots and boat landings.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of lakeshore: The edge of a lake, with possible beaches, reeds, fishing spots and boat landings.
flavour: Small waves spread over the stones, leaving them dark and shining. Their soft hiss mingles with rustling reeds and the smell of sun-warmed mud.
discovery: A partly buried mooring post bears waterline marks that show the lake once stood much higher.
readAloud: A pebbled shore curves around the lake between low reeds and rocks polished smooth by the water.

name: Waterfall Pool
description: A pool beneath falling water, surrounded by slippery rocks and loud rushing water.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of waterfall pool: A pool beneath falling water, surrounded by slippery rocks and loud rushing water.
flavour: Spray hangs above the surface and settles cool against your skin. The waterfall’s roar fills the hollow as pale foam turns along the pool’s edge.
discovery: Behind a curtain of spray, a narrow dry shelf holds the remains of a carefully stacked stone marker.
readAloud: A white curtain of falling water plunges into a dark pool ringed by slick rocks and dripping greenery.

name: Animal Den
description: A sheltered place where an animal sleeps or raises its young, such as a burrow, cave or hollow beneath roots.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of animal den: A sheltered place where an animal sleeps or raises its young, such as a burrow, cave or hollow beneath roots.
flavour: Scratched earth leads into the darkness, where something rustles faintly out of sight. A musky smell drifts from within, mingling with damp soil.
discovery: Among old bones near the entrance lies a worked metal clasp with a torn piece of fabric still attached.
readAloud: A low opening disappears beneath tangled roots, with loose fur caught around its worn entrance.

name: Abandoned Logging Camp
description: A former base for timber workers, with empty huts, tool sheds, stacked logs and hauling tracks.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of abandoned logging camp: A former base for timber workers, with empty huts, tool sheds, stacked logs and hauling tracks.
flavour: Loose boards creak as the wind passes through the buildings. Damp sawdust and rotting timber scent the air while a rusty chain taps against a shed wall.
discovery: A tally board records deliveries made after the camp appears to have been abandoned.
readAloud: Sagging huts and empty sheds stand beside stacked logs and hauling tracks buried in grass.

name: Ravine Crossing
description: A place to cross a deep, narrow gap using a bridge, fallen tree or narrow ledge.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of ravine crossing: A place to cross a deep, narrow gap using a bridge, fallen tree or narrow ledge.
flavour: Dust lifts from the edge as wind funnels through the gap. A dislodged pebble vanishes below, its distant impacts arriving a moment later.
discovery: Old footholds cut into the rock reveal a second crossing route beneath the visible one.
readAloud: A narrow crossing stretches between jagged rock faces above a deep, shadowed ravine.

name: Overgrown Homestead
description: A deserted rural home with a cottage, well, garden or barn overtaken by vegetation and partly collapsed.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of overgrown homestead: A deserted rural home with a cottage, well, garden or barn overtaken by vegetation and partly collapsed.
flavour: Branches reach through broken windows and scrape against the sagging roof. Wet leaves and mould scent the shade beneath the tangled growth.
discovery: A covered well contains a waterproof tin wedged above the waterline, filled with faded family papers.
readAloud: Vines climb a deserted cottage beside a leaning barn and garden beds swallowed by weeds.

name: Gatehouse
description: A fortified entrance where guards control access through gates, sometimes with a heavy sliding grille called a portcullis.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of gatehouse: A fortified entrance where guards control access through gates, sometimes with a heavy sliding grille called a portcullis.
flavour: Thick chains run from the grille into dark openings in the masonry. Your footsteps echo through the cool passage, where damp mortar and lamp smoke scent the air.
discovery: A small inspection hatch reveals an older passage sealed behind the gate mechanism.
readAloud: A stone archway passes beneath the gatehouse, with a heavy iron grille suspended above the entrance.

name: Courtyard
description: An outdoor space enclosed by walls or buildings, used for deliveries, daily work and access to nearby rooms.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of courtyard: An outdoor space enclosed by walls or buildings, used for deliveries, daily work and access to nearby rooms.
flavour: The cloth stirs overhead, casting moving shadows across shallow puddles. Kitchen smoke drifts between the walls while cart wheels scrape over the uneven ground.
discovery: A drain grate covers a narrow channel containing a recently dropped key and fresh candle wax.
readAloud: Paving stones fill an enclosed courtyard beneath shuttered windows and lines of hanging laundry.

name: Great Hall
description: A large room for meals, gatherings and receiving visitors, where a lord or commander may conduct business.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of great hall: A large room for meals, gatherings and receiving visitors, where a lord or commander may conduct business.
flavour: Firelight moves across the benches and wall hangings as smoke gathers overhead. The air smells of wax and spilled wine, and every footstep carries across the stone floor.
discovery: A movable panel behind a wall hanging exposes an older carving deliberately hidden from the hall.
readAloud: Long tables stretch beneath high rafters toward a raised seat at the far end of the hall.

name: Kitchen and Pantry
description: Rooms for preparing meals and storing food, utensils and ingredients.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of kitchen and pantry: Rooms for preparing meals and storing food, utensils and ingredients.
flavour: Steam rises from the cooking vessels and clouds a nearby window. Herbs and fresh bread scent the warmth as a ladle taps against the rim of a pot.
discovery: A flour bin has a false bottom holding a wrapped packet of letters kept away from kitchen damp.
readAloud: Iron pots hang above crowded preparation tables beside a pantry lined with jars and sacks.

name: Barracks
description: Shared accommodation for soldiers or guards, with beds, personal storage and equipment.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of barracks: Shared accommodation for soldiers or guards, with beds, personal storage and equipment.
flavour: A draft stirs a hanging strap, making its buckle tap against a bedframe. The room smells of boot leather, wool and recently extinguished lamp oil.
discovery: A loose bed slat carries a list of dates and places carved where only its occupant would see it.
readAloud: Rows of narrow beds stand beside storage chests, folded blankets and neatly arranged equipment.

name: Armory
description: A secure room storing weapons, armor and military supplies, with controlled access.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of armory: A secure room storing weapons, armor and military supplies, with controlled access.
flavour: A stripe of daylight catches polished metal and scratches across the floor. Cold air carries the smell of oil, and a loose hanging buckle clicks against a breastplate.
discovery: An inventory tag lists a piece of equipment that is missing from its rack, though the dust around it is undisturbed.
readAloud: Racks of weapons and armour line the walls beneath a narrow, shuttered window.

name: Storeroom
description: A room holding supplies such as oil, rope, tools and provisions, often packed with shelves, crates and barrels.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of storeroom: A room holding supplies such as oil, rope, tools and provisions, often packed with shelves, crates and barrels.
flavour: Dust lies across the upper shelves and rises where a sack has split. The air smells of dry rope and lamp oil, with occasional wooden clicks from the crowded stacks.
discovery: Several crates share an identical shipping mark, but one is much lighter and has a concealed compartment.
readAloud: Shelves, crates and barrels crowd the room, leaving narrow passages between stacks of supplies.

name: Guardroom
description: A duty station where guards wait and monitor a nearby entrance or passage.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of guardroom: A duty station where guards wait and monitor a nearby entrance or passage.
flavour: Its remaining embers glow beneath a layer of gray ash. The smell of charcoal lingers as sounds from the adjoining passage carry into the room.
discovery: A scratched diagram beneath the duty desk shows a blind corner absent from the official plan of the passages.
readAloud: A plain desk and waiting bench face the doorway beside a small iron brazier.

name: Prison Cells
description: Small locked rooms for captives, usually reached through a guarded corridor, with basic furnishings.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of prison cells: Small locked rooms for captives, usually reached through a guarded corridor, with basic furnishings.
flavour: A draft stirs scraps of straw beneath the bars. Damp stone and cold iron scent the air while a distant drip echoes along the corridor.
discovery: A loose stone beneath a sleeping bench opens onto a small hiding place containing a worn file and a folded note.
readAloud: Iron-barred doors line a stone corridor, with narrow sleeping benches visible inside the cells.

name: Servants’ Passage
description: A secondary corridor or stairway allowing household staff to move between working rooms and living quarters.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of servants’ passage: A secondary corridor or stairway allowing household staff to move between working rooms and living quarters.
flavour: The walls draw close around each turn, carrying footsteps from the rooms beyond. Cooking smells and soap linger in the air beside the old plaster.
discovery: A discoloured wall panel opens onto a forgotten cupboard with sightlines into an adjoining room.
readAloud: Plain doors line a narrow corridor leading to a steep staircase with a polished wooden banister.

name: Cistern Chamber
description: A chamber containing a tank or reservoir of stored water to supply the building.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of cistern chamber: A chamber containing a tank or reservoir of stored water to supply the building.
flavour: Falling drops spread pale rings across its still surface. Their hollow echoes fill the cool chamber, where the air smells faintly of minerals.
discovery: An old maintenance mark points to a ledge above the water where a sealed clay vessel rests in the shadows.
readAloud: Dark water fills a stone reservoir beneath walls streaked with moisture.

name: Burial Vault
description: An enclosed room, usually underground, containing coffins or tombs belonging to a family or former occupants.
imageAlt: Fantasy illustration of burial vault: An enclosed room, usually underground, containing coffins or tombs belonging to a family or former occupants.
flavour: Dust softens the lettering and gathers in the corners beneath hanging cobwebs. A faint draft brushes your skin, carrying the dry smell of old stone.
discovery: One memorial slab bears a second name beneath its edge, carefully chiselled away but not entirely erased.
readAloud: Sealed coffins and stone tombs occupy a low chamber beneath rows of carved memorial slabs.

name: Ritual Chamber
description: A circular stone chamber surrounds an altar, with carved floor sigils and clusters of candles. A faint violet glow lingers over the prepared ritual; one place remains conspicuously empty.
imageAlt: A candlelit stone ritual chamber with carved floor sigils and a violet-lit central altar
flavour: A faint violet glow traces the grooves between pools of hardened wax. Burnt herbs scent the cold air, and even a small movement echoes around the chamber.
discovery: Dust outlines a missing object beside the altar, and a narrow groove connects its place to the floor carvings.
readAloud: Carved circles and angular sigils surround a stone altar crowded with candles and darkened bowls.

name: Forgotten Storeroom
description: Dusty crates, cracked barrels and crowded shelves fill a cramped underground storeroom. Fresh footprints cut through the dust toward a crate that shifts from within.
imageAlt: An underground storeroom of dusty wooden crates, barrels and shelves lit by a warm lantern
flavour: Cobwebs stretch between the stacks, trembling where the air moves through them. The room smells of old wood, and a slow scraping comes from behind the crates.
discovery: A hollow space behind a shifted crate contains a recent bundle wrapped in cloth much cleaner than its surroundings.
readAloud: Dust-coated crates and cracked barrels fill a cramped chamber beneath shelves bowed with age.

name: Prison Cells
description: Rusted iron bars divide a damp stone corridor into narrow cells, beside an abandoned guard’s desk. One locked cell is spotless, with a warm meal waiting inside.
imageAlt: Rusted iron prison cells along a damp stone corridor with shackles and an abandoned guard desk
flavour: Moisture glistens on the iron and runs down the stone walls. A cold draft carries the smell of old straw as faint metallic tapping comes from the desk.
discovery: One locked cell is conspicuously clean, and the bowl inside still holds a warm meal beside fresh footprints.
readAloud: Rusted bars divide a damp corridor into cramped cells beside an abandoned guard’s desk.

name: Wizard’s Tower
description: A secluded tower used for magical study, with a workroom, shelves of spellbooks and an upper chamber for observing the sky. Visitors may seek advice, rare knowledge or help with an unusual enchantment.
imageAlt: Round stone wizard’s tower with a slate roof, glowing windows and a study doorway amid forested hills.
flavour: Light from an upper window catches brass fittings and glass lenses. A breeze turns the pages of an unfinished chart, carrying the smell of ink and drying herbs.
discovery: An observation chart marks a recurring light in the sky that does not appear on the tower’s older maps.
readAloud: A spiral staircase climbs past shelves of books, pinned charts and tables crowded with strange instruments.

name: Ship
description: A wooden sailing vessel carrying passengers or cargo, with an open deck, rigging, a captain’s cabin and storage below. It can serve as a harbor meeting place or a base for a voyage.
imageAlt: Wooden sailing ship deck with furled canvas sails, rigging, cargo barrels and a calm harbor beyond the rails.
flavour: The deck shifts gently beneath your feet as canvas rustles overhead. Tar and salt-damp timber scent the breeze while water knocks against the hull.
discovery: A cargo plank has been recently lifted, revealing a wrapped parcel absent from the loading list.
readAloud: Ropes and rigging rise above a wooden deck crowded with lashed barrels and covered cargo.

name: Mine / Quarry
description: A working site where miners extract ore underground and quarry workers cut stone from exposed rock. Timber supports, hauling tracks and lifting gear surround the entrances and work areas.
imageAlt: Rocky quarry with a timber-supported mine entrance, ore cart tracks, stacked stone and a wooden lifting frame.
flavour: Pale dust hangs around the entrance as cool air flows from the darkness. Picks ring deeper inside, answered by the rattle of a lifting chain.
discovery: A freshly split block exposes a worked surface inside the rock, bearing marks unlike those left by the quarry tools.
readAloud: Hauling tracks pass stacks of cut stone and disappear into a timber-framed opening in the rock face.

name: Academy / Library
description: A place of learning with bookshelves, reading tables and rooms for lessons or research. Scholars, scribes and students gather here to consult records, copy texts and investigate unfamiliar subjects.
imageAlt: Medieval library with tall oak bookshelves, stone arches, reading tables and a brass armillary sphere in soft daylight.
flavour: Daylight picks out floating dust above open books and scattered notes. Pages whisper in the quiet, and the aisles smell of paper and leather bindings.
discovery: Marginal notes in unrelated books use the same small symbol to point toward a shelf omitted from the catalogue.
readAloud: Tall bookshelves surround broad reading tables beneath stone arches and high windows.

name: Traveling Carnival
description: A temporary gathering of entertainers and vendors who travel with tents and wagons. A performance tent, small stage and lantern-lit paths offer places to meet performers, trade rumors or discover a hidden trouble.
imageAlt: Medieval traveling carnival with burgundy and ivory tents, timber wagons, lanterns and a small stage beside a country road.
flavour: Ribbons flutter against the tent ropes as shadows move across the canvas. Music drifts between the wagons, mingling with lantern smoke and the smell of sweet fried dough.
discovery: A painted sign has been reversed, and its hidden side shows directions to a stopping place absent from the public route.
readAloud: Painted wagons and colourful tents surround a small stage along paths lined with lanterns.

name: Campsite with Fire
description: A simple overnight resting place in the wilderness, with a small fire and bedrolls; useful for watches and conversations during a rest.
readAloud: A small fire glows inside a rough ring of stones, with a few bedrolls and travel packs lying on the ground beneath the dark trees.
flavour: Woodsmoke drifts through the clearing as the flames crackle and settle. Beyond their warm circle of light, leaves rustle in the night breeze.
discovery: Fresh bootprints circle the camp before disappearing between the trees, though no one remembers hearing a visitor.
imageAlt: Painted fantasy illustration of a sparse wilderness camp at night with a small fire, bedrolls, travel packs and a cooking pot.

name: Alleyway
description: A narrow passage between buildings that offers a shortcut, a discreet meeting place or a possible ambush route.
readAloud: A narrow cobbled passage runs between leaning buildings, with stacked crates beside a dark doorway and daylight at the far end.
flavour: Water drips from a sagging gutter into the puddles underfoot. The bustle of the main street fades behind you, leaving the scrape of your footsteps against the stone.
discovery: Behind a loose crate, a small chalk arrow points toward a door with a freshly replaced lock.
imageAlt: Painted fantasy illustration of a shadowed medieval alley with cobblestones, crates, hanging laundry and a sunlit exit.

name: Farm
description: A working property on the rural outskirts, with fields, livestock and outbuildings; a place to seek food, shelter, local news or everyday work.
readAloud: Rows of crops stretch beside a timber farmhouse and barn, with fresh wagon tracks crossing the yard and chickens pecking along the fence.
flavour: The smell of turned earth mingles with hay as a light breeze stirs the washing on the line. From behind the barn comes the steady knock of someone repairing a gate.
discovery: A line of crushed plants leads from the field to a broken fence, where a scrap of unfamiliar cloth catches on a nail.
imageAlt: Painted fantasy illustration of an isolated working farm with a farmhouse, barn, crop rows, chickens and tools, backed by open fields and wooded hills.

name: Crypt
description: An underground burial chamber with stone coffins, burial niches and disturbed graves, suited to tomb exploration and signs of recent intrusion.
imageAlt: Illustrated crypt with stone coffins, burial niches, a displaced sarcophagus lid and candlelit vaulted arches.
readAloud: Stone coffins fill a vaulted chamber lined with burial niches, and a heavy lid lies displaced beside an open sarcophagus.
flavour: Cold air carries the dry smell of dust and old candle wax. Grit crunches underfoot, and fresh scrape marks cut through the dust beside the disturbed graves.
discovery: Behind a loose burial plaque lies a folded map of the lower passages, with one sealed tomb marked in fresh ink.

name: Alchemist’s Laboratory
description: An abandoned workshop containing broken vessels, unstable mixtures and unfinished experiments, offering clues, salvage and possible hazards.
imageAlt: Illustrated abandoned alchemist’s laboratory with broken glass vessels, copper apparatus and glowing amber and green mixtures.
readAloud: Broken vessels and scattered notes surround a cluttered workbench, where amber and green mixtures glow beneath a tangle of copper pipes.
flavour: A sharp mineral smell hangs over the tables, and sticky spills glisten between shards of glass. From the copper apparatus comes a slow bubbling, though nobody tends the experiment.
discovery: A notebook tucked beneath the workbench records a failed antidote; its final page names the missing ingredient and a nearby source.

name: Cavern Pool
description: A still underground pool bordered by glowing fungi and damp rock shelves, with clear shallows that hint at submerged secrets.
imageAlt: Illustrated limestone cavern with a still blue-green pool, glowing fungi and a carved stone arch beneath the water.
readAloud: Glowing fungi trace the edge of a still cavern pool, and a carved stone arch rests beneath its clear blue-green shallows.
flavour: Cool moisture settles on your skin as scattered drops echo from the stalactites. Blue light trembles across the wet rocks, fading where the water deepens into darkness.
discovery: Beyond the submerged arch, a narrow passage rises into an air pocket where a sealed travel case rests above the waterline.

name: Caravanserai
description: A walled roadside lodging and trading compound where caravans rest, stable pack animals, store cargo and exchange news.
readAloud: A broad courtyard opens beyond a heavy timber gate, with loaded wagons resting beneath shaded stone arcades and pack animals tethered beside a water trough.
flavour: Harness buckles clink as stablehands lead tired animals toward fresh hay. The air carries the smell of dust, warm bread and cooking spices beneath the murmur of bargaining travelers.
discovery: A loose stone beside the watering trough conceals a folded cargo receipt with several crate numbers crossed out and replaced in different handwriting.
imageAlt: Illustrated caravanserai courtyard enclosed by sandstone walls with a timber gateway, shaded arcade, loaded wagon, tethered pack animals and a central water trough.

name: Charcoal Burner’s Kiln
description: A woodland worksite where timber is slowly burned beneath an earth-covered kiln to produce charcoal for blacksmiths, merchants and other tradespeople.
readAloud: A low, earth-covered charcoal kiln smoulders in a forest workyard beside stacked timber, soot-dark sacks and a rough lean-to shelter.
flavour: Thin smoke threads through the branches, carrying the sharp scent of hot wood and damp soil. Somewhere beneath the kiln’s clay covering, embers crackle while a shovel scrapes against the packed earth.
discovery: One sack marked for charcoal holds iron fittings wrapped in soot-stained cloth, with a delivery tally tucked beneath its binding cord.
imageAlt: Earth-covered charcoal kiln smoking gently in a woodland clearing beside stacked timber, sacks, a shovel and a rough lean-to shelter.

name: Glassblower’s Workshop
description: A specialist workshop where molten glass is shaped into bottles, lenses, beads and decorative wares around a fiercely heated furnace.
readAloud: A round brick furnace glows at the center of a cramped workshop, surrounded by long iron pipes, a scarred worktable and shelves of coloured glass.
flavour: Heat presses against your face, carrying the mineral tang of ash and hot metal. Cooling glass ticks softly on the shelves while the furnace roars beneath a haze of smoke.
discovery: A cloudy blue bottle on the cooling rack contains a sealed scrap of vellum, though its narrow neck is too small for the rolled message to have been inserted after firing.
imageAlt: Painterly fantasy glassblower’s workshop with a glowing brick furnace, long blowpipes, a metal worktable and shelves of coloured glass vessels.

name: Apiary
description: A working yard where beekeepers tend straw skeps and timber hives, press honeycomb and prepare honey and wax for trade.
readAloud: Rows of woven skeps and timber hives stand among wildflowers beside an open shelter crowded with honey jars and a wooden press.
flavour: Bees drift between the blossoms in a steady golden haze, their hum rising and falling with the breeze. Warm wax and crushed herbs scent the air while honey glistens in shallow bowls beneath the shelter.
discovery: A hive at the edge of the yard has been built around a small stone coffer; fresh wax seals its lid, but the bees leave the narrow seam untouched.
imageAlt: Painterly fantasy apiary with woven straw skeps, timber hives, wildflowers, honey jars and a wooden press beneath a rustic shelter.

name: Public Bathhouse
description: A communal bathing house with heated pools, changing benches and washing rooms where residents gather, recover and exchange news.
readAloud: Steam drifts above tiled bathing pools beneath arched stone ceilings, with folded linens and copper basins arranged along wooden benches.
flavour: Warm mineral water laps against the pool steps while droplets patter from the vaulted ceiling. Soap, damp stone and herbal oils scent the heavy air beyond a screen of rising steam.
discovery: A narrow maintenance grate beneath the hottest pool holds a sealed brass cylinder wedged against the drain bars, its surface still warm to the touch.
imageAlt: Painterly fantasy public bathhouse with steaming tiled pools, arched stone ceilings, folded linens, copper basins and wooden benches.

name: Dyer’s Yard
description: A workshop yard where cloth and yarn are boiled in dye vats, rinsed and hung to dry before sale or further finishing.
readAloud: Rows of brightly dyed cloth hang above steaming copper vats, wooden rinsing troughs and worktables stained in overlapping colours.
flavour: Hot steam carries the sharp scent of vinegar, wet wool and crushed roots across the yard. Coloured water trickles through shallow channels while suspended fabric snaps softly in the breeze.
discovery: One drying length shows a pale repeating pattern beneath its blue dye, revealing writing woven into the cloth that becomes visible only while wet.
imageAlt: Painterly fantasy dyer’s yard with steaming copper vats, timber rinsing troughs, dye-stained worktables and bright cloth hanging from wooden racks.

name: Ropewalk
description: A long, narrow workshop where flax, hemp and other fibres are spun, stretched and twisted into cordage for ships, farms and builders.
readAloud: A roofed timber lane stretches between turning wheels and pegged racks, with pale fibres drawn into long strands above coils of finished rope.
flavour: Dry hemp scratches beneath every step, filling the air with a grassy, dusty scent. Wooden hooks chatter in sequence as taut strands creak and tighten down the length of the shed.
discovery: One coil carries a line of differently knotted fibres beneath its outer wrap, forming a compact route diagram when the rope is unrolled.
imageAlt: Painterly fantasy ropewalk with a wooden twisting wheel, long taut fibre strands, pegged supports, hemp bundles, tar pots and coils of finished rope.
